description: This file defines the CartBadgeController class which manages the cart badge UI element within a Toolbar menu item in an Android application. It handles updating the badge count, visibility, and click behavior.

classes.name: CartBadgeController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the cart badge's UI, updating its count, and handling click interactions.

methods.name: setCount
methods.description: Updates the badge's visibility and text based on the count; hides the badge if count is zero or less, shows and displays count otherwise.

methods.name: setOnClickListener
methods.description: Sets a click listener on the badge's action view to trigger the provided lambda when clicked.

methods.name: inflateActionView
methods.description: A private extension function on Toolbar to inflate the custom cart badge layout as a view.
